reasoning_content:
I need to verify whether the `AppLayout.vue` file is actually part of the MainPage module tree that Vite serves, since the Inertia page itself is rendered on the server side but the module imports need to be resolvable client-side. The guide claims 18 out of 18 reachable modules resolved successfully, so if AppLayout were actually needed by MainPage, that would contradict what Vite's module graph shows.

Let me check what MainPage.vue is actually importing — so far I've seen Navigation, Head, Vue utilities, SensorComponent, Ochsi, Sensor, HomeInfoCard, and SensorCard — and I need to verify whether it imports AppLayout or any of those layout components, and also confirm that AppHeader.vue isn't somehow being referenced through a glob import.

action.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== ALL imports in MainPage.vue ==="; grep -nE "import|from '" resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue | head -40; echo; echo "=== import.meta.glob in app.ts ==="; grep -n "import.meta.glob" resources/js/app.ts; echo; echo "=== Does MainPage import any layout? ==="; grep -n "Layout" resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue || echo "NO layout imports in MainPage.vue"
